entry.title: Perform Asset Posting with SAP PaPM
entry.content:
Dear community,

I am working on a SAP Profitability and Performance Management model which generates as output lines to be posted as asset postings (document type
My idea was to use the remote function adapter with the standard Finance General Ledger Items function using the BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST BAPI, but I am struggling to set it right, even by passing additional attributes by mean of the extension2 values.

The test that I set up has to produce one document, with type AA, having two distinct line items: one with account type 'A' (asset) and one with account type 'S' (G/L account).

This is how I am filling the header and GL areas:

Header
Document Type: AA
Posting Date: 04.12.2025
Document Date: 04.12.2025
Company Code: XXXX (one company code defined in the system)
User Name: my username

Line Item 1 (the one to be the document type A)
WBS: a valid wbs element ID
Transaction type: 145
Asset Number: a valid asset number (with zero left padding)
Asset subnumber: 0000
Asset Transaction Type: 100
Account Type: A
Tax Code: a valid tax code
Currency: EUR
Amount: 1000

Line Item 2 (the one to be the document type S)
WBS: a valid wbs element ID (same as line item 1)
GL Account: a valid GL account
Account Type: S
Tax Code: a valid tax code (same as line item 1)
Currency: EUR
Amount: -1000


The values highlighted with purple color are those sent to the BAPI via the extension2 values. When I run the function I get the error: "Required field G/L account was not transferred in parameter ACCOUNTGL". The error refers to the line item 1, but the asset posting should not require a GL account on the account type 'A' as it should be automatically derived.
However, to try overcoming this error I saw online that some people using the same bapi, directly from abap, are filling the G/L account parameter with the asset number itself. I tried doing the same but then the following error comes out: "G/L account <asset number> is not defined in chart of account XYZ".

With a developer we also tried hard coding the posting keys to 70 (debit asset) for line item 1 and 50 (credit entry) for the line item 2, but it didn't change the outcome.

Did anyone also faced the same issue before, or has any experience with asset posting through BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST that could help overcoming this block?

I am available to provide any further detail.

Thank you in advance and best regards,
Francesco

entry.title: Lookup formula in Calculation function
entry.content:
Environment: SAP Profitability and Performance Management 3.0 SP22, On-Premise.

Lookup formula in Calculation function: right-hand join key always quoted as string literal in generated HANA code

Hello,

I am trying to enrich my input data in a Calculation function by pulling fields from another Model Table via a Lookup formula, following the approach from the sample content and older community posts.

Setup:

  • Calculation type: Relative
  • Input function: Model Table 13852 (main stream)
  • Lookup tab: Model Table 13854 added
  • In the Action of my first rule, I want to fill the field COUNTERPARTY_TYPE from table 13854, joined on COUNTERPARTY_ID.

Formula I entered:

 
13854.COUNTERPARTY_TYPE[COUNTERPARTY_ID=COUNTERPARTY_ID]

Problem: In the generated HANA code, the right-hand side of the join condition is always wrapped in single quotes, so it is treated as a string literal instead of a field reference from the main stream:

 
sql
IFNULL((SELECT MAX(COUNTERPARTY_TYPE) FROM "SAPDB"."Y820HZL000513854"
        WHERE (COUNTERPARTY_ID = 'COUNTERPARTY_ID')), TO_NVARCHAR('')) AS COUNTERPARTY_TYPE

Because of this, the lookup never matches any row and always returns the empty default. The enriched field stays blank, and all my downstream rules that depend on it do not trigger.

What I already tried (each one re-activated and re-checked in the generated code):

Formula Generated WHERE clause
...[COUNTERPARTY_ID=M.COUNTERPARTY_ID]WHERE (COUNTERPARTY_ID = 'M.COUNTERPARTY_ID')
...[COUNTERPARTY_ID=COUNTERPARTY_ID]WHERE (COUNTERPARTY_ID = 'COUNTERPARTY_ID')
...[COUNTERPARTY_ID=$COUNTERPARTY_ID]WHERE (COUNTERPARTY_ID = '$COUNTERPARTY_ID')

In every case the right-hand value is quoted as a literal string. The main stream is aliased as AS M in the generated code, so I expected M.COUNTERPARTY_ID to work as a field reference, but it is quoted too.

My questions:

  1. How do I enter the main-stream field on the right-hand side of the lookup condition so that it is interpreted as a field reference and not as a string literal?
  2. Is there a dedicated field picker in the formula editor for this, instead of typing the field name as text?
  3. Is the bracket lookup syntax FID.FIELD[KEY=KEY] still supported in 3.0 SP22, or has the recommended approach changed (e.g. using the Lookup tab join configuration instead of a formula)

Any guidance on the correct syntax or configuration would be greatly appreciated. Thank you!

  • Cloud Connector has been configured and is showing as reachable.
  • The BTP Destination has been created and is also reachable.
  • I tested the BW OData service in Gateway Client, and the execution returns HTTP 200 without errors. I can also see data being returned from the Entity Set successfully.

However, when creating the connection in PaPM UM and clicking Test Connection, I receive the following error:


"Metadata for destination XXX and service path sap/opu/odata/sap/Z_C_ZGHG_CONSUME_CDS cannot be retrieved."


The issue is that the error details in UM seem to contain only this message, so I'm not sure where to continue troubleshooting.

 
I've performed similar OData integrations from an OP system to PAPM UM in other environments before, and they worked successfully.
 
However, in my current system, I configured the internal host in Cloud Connector using an IP address (192.xxx.x.x) rather than the actual hostname. (I didn't use actual host name because it will lead to cloud connector error like java.net.unknownhostexception: myhostname: name or service unknown.) I just checked the Cloud Connector logs and found the following entries. I'm not sure whether this is merely noise or if it is actually the reason why the PaPM OData connection is failing:

entry.title: Table remains empty after replicating changes between SAP PaPM model versions
entry.content:
Hello, SAP Community,

I am relatively new to SAP PaPM and currently have two versions of the same model:

  • Version 1: Production model.
  • Version 2: Testing model.

In Version 2, I implemented a change in the modeling flow consisting of a JOIN function with a simple aggregation. I then added this function to the process, executed the flow, and the JOIN table was populated correctly.

However, after replicating the exact same configuration in Version 1, the execution completes successfully, but the table remains empty.

I have already verified that the JOIN configuration and the process are apparently the same in both versions.

Does anyone know what could be causing this behavior? Is there any additional step required when replicating functions between model versions, such as reactivating the functions, updating the process, or regenerating any objects?

Thank you in advance for your support.
